scripts.types: bunx --bun --no-install civet --emit-declaration src/client.civet src/server.civet src/database.civet src/capabilities.civet src/server/capabilities.civet src/server/capabilities-loader.civet src/server/capability-readiness.civet
scripts.typecheck: bunx --bun --no-install civet --typecheck src/client.civet src/server.civet src/database.civet src/capabilities.civet src/server/capabilities.civet src/server/capabilities-loader.civet src/server/capability-readiness.civet src/*.test.civet
scripts.test: bun run types && corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --project unit src/*.test.civet
scripts.test:unit: bun run types && corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --project unit src/*.test.civet
